fields.why: Incidence and relative survival are reported and ranked across 5 race/ethnicity groups and 8 age groups (Tables 1-3; 'highest among API, followed by...').
Sex only defines the population and SES enters only through the expected life tables, so age and race/ethnicity are the groupwise dimensions.

The survival claims ('highest', 'higher') rest on the CI-overlap rule stated once in the methods, which the brief assigns to per-group vs referent only; that rule covers relative survival only, so the incidence rankings by race and age stay side by side and the mechanical flags on those entries are false alarms.
